theorems.name: PersistentNaming.WireBound.encLen_le_bound
theorems.type: ∀ {v : PersistentNaming.WireBound.Val} {t : PersistentNaming.WireBound.Ty} {b : Nat}, PersistentNaming.WireBound.HasType v t → PersistentNaming.WireBound.bound t = Option.some b → PersistentNaming.WireBound.encLen v ≤ b

theorems.name: PersistentNaming.WireBound.text_unbounded
theorems.type: PersistentNaming.WireBound.bound PersistentNaming.WireBound.Ty.text = Option.none

theorems.name: PersistentNaming.WireBound.fieldsLen_le_bound
theorems.type: ∀ {fs : List (Nat × PersistentNaming.WireBound.Ty)} {vs : List PersistentNaming.WireBound.Val} {b : Nat}, PersistentNaming.WireBound.FieldsTyped fs vs → PersistentNaming.WireBound.fieldsBound fs = Option.some b → PersistentNaming.WireBound.fieldsLen fs vs ≤ b

theorems.name: PersistentNaming.WireBound.split_chain_birth_bounded
theorems.type: ∀ (d : PersistentNaming.WireBound.Disc) (b schemeLen occurrenceLen roleLen : Nat), PersistentNaming.WireBound.fieldsBound d.fields = Option.some b → ∃ K, ∀ (depth : Nat) (chain : Nat → List PersistentNaming.WireBound.Val) (parents : Nat → Nat), (∀ i, i < depth → PersistentNaming.WireBound.FieldsTyped d.fields (chain i) ∧ parents i ≤ 1) → ∀ i, i < depth → PersistentNaming.WireBound.birthLen schemeLen occurrenceLen roleLen (parents i) (PersistentNaming.WireBound.discLen d (chain i)) ≤ K

theorems.name: PersistentNaming.MintOrder.kahn_steps_bounded
theorems.type: ∀ (n : Nat) (releases : Nat → List Nat), (∀ x p, p ∈ releases x → p < n) → ∀ (ready₀ : List Nat) (waits₀ : Nat → Nat), ready₀.length ≤ n → ∀ (fuel : Nat) (s' : PersistentNaming.MintOrder.State), PersistentNaming.MintOrder.run releases fuel { ready := ready₀, waits := waits₀, steps := 0 } = Option.some s' → s'.steps ≤ n + 2 * PersistentNaming.MintOrder.sumTo waits₀ n

theorems.name: PersistentNaming.PostureCost.commit_naming_steps_bounded
theorems.type: ∀ (basis : PersistentNaming.PostureCost.Basis) (changed : Nat) (claims : List PersistentNaming.PostureCost.Claim) (mintOrderSteps : Nat) (births : List PersistentNaming.PostureCost.Birth), PersistentNaming.PostureCost.commitSteps basis changed claims mintOrderSteps births = 3 * changed + PersistentNaming.PostureCost.sumMap (fun c => 1 + c.fanout + c.lookups.length) claims + mintOrderSteps + PersistentNaming.PostureCost.sumMap (fun b => 1 + b.parents.length + b.references.length + b.discBytes) births

theorems.name: PersistentNaming.PostureCost.commit_naming_steps_basis_independent
theorems.type: ∀ (small large : PersistentNaming.PostureCost.Basis) (changed : Nat) (claims : List PersistentNaming.PostureCost.Claim) (mintOrderSteps : Nat) (births : List PersistentNaming.PostureCost.Birth), PersistentNaming.PostureCost.commitSteps small changed claims mintOrderSteps births = PersistentNaming.PostureCost.commitSteps large changed claims mintOrderSteps births

theorems.name: PersistentNaming.TimelineSearch.search_steps_le_log
theorems.type: ∀ (a : Nat → Nat) (basis lo size : Nat), (PersistentNaming.TimelineSearch.search a basis lo size).2 ≤ Nat.log2 size + 1

theorems.name: PersistentNaming.TimelineSearch.search_eq_scan
theorems.type: ∀ (a : Nat → Nat) (basis lo size : Nat), (∀ i j, lo ≤ i → i ≤ j → j < lo + size → a i ≤ a j) → (PersistentNaming.TimelineSearch.search a basis lo size).1 = PersistentNaming.TimelineSearch.scan a basis lo size

theorems.name: PersistentNaming.NameResolution.resolve_visits_lineage_path
theorems.type: ∀ (idx : Nat → Option PersistentNaming.NameResolution.Entry) (basis held fuel : Nat), (∀ k, k ∈ (PersistentNaming.NameResolution.resolve idx basis held fuel).visited → PersistentNaming.NameResolution.Reach idx basis held k) ∧ (PersistentNaming.NameResolution.resolve idx basis held fuel).probes = (PersistentNaming.NameResolution.resolve idx basis held fuel).visited.length ∧ (PersistentNaming.NameResolution.resolve idx basis held fuel).visited.Nodup

theorems.name: PersistentNaming.NameResolution.resolve_steps_independent_of_unrelated
theorems.type: ∀ (idx idx' : Nat → Option PersistentNaming.NameResolution.Entry) (basis held fuel : Nat), (∀ k, PersistentNaming.NameResolution.Reach idx basis held k → idx k = idx' k) → (PersistentNaming.NameResolution.resolve idx basis held fuel).steps = (PersistentNaming.NameResolution.resolve idx' basis held fuel).steps

theorems.name: PersistentNaming.NameResolution.resolve_steps_bounded
theorems.type: ∀ (idx : Nat → Option PersistentNaming.NameResolution.Entry) (basis held fuel Tmax : Nat), (∀ k e, PersistentNaming.NameResolution.Reach idx basis held k → idx k = Option.some e → e.len ≤ Tmax ∧ e.edgeLen ≤ Tmax) → (PersistentNaming.NameResolution.resolve idx basis held fuel).steps ≤ ((PersistentNaming.NameResolution.resolve idx basis held fuel).probes + (PersistentNaming.NameResolution.resolve idx basis held fuel).edges) * (3 * (Nat.log2 Tmax + 2))

theorems.name: PersistentNaming.IndexDelta.rollback_restores
theorems.type: ∀ (c : Nat) (ops : List PersistentNaming.IndexDelta.Op) (s : PersistentNaming.IndexDelta.Store), (∀ k l, s k = Option.some l → ∀ e, e ∈ l → e.1 < c) → PersistentNaming.IndexDelta.rollback (PersistentNaming.IndexDelta.applyAll c ops (PersistentNaming.IndexDelta.init s)).journal (PersistentNaming.IndexDelta.applyAll c ops (PersistentNaming.IndexDelta.init s)).state = s

theorems.name: PersistentNaming.IndexDelta.batch_refused_restores
theorems.type: ∀ (c : Nat) (ops : List PersistentNaming.IndexDelta.Op) (s : PersistentNaming.IndexDelta.Store), (∀ k l, s k = Option.some l → ∀ e, e ∈ l → e.1 < c) → (PersistentNaming.IndexDelta.applyAll c ops (PersistentNaming.IndexDelta.init s)).refused = true → (PersistentNaming.IndexDelta.batch c ops s).1 = s

theorems.name: PersistentNaming.IndexDelta.batch_steps_bounded
theorems.type: ∀ (c : Nat) (ops : List PersistentNaming.IndexDelta.Op) (s : PersistentNaming.IndexDelta.Store), (PersistentNaming.IndexDelta.batch c ops s).2 ≤ 3 * ops.length

theorems.name: PersistentNaming.IndexDelta.apply_steps_independent_of_history
theorems.type: ∀ (c : Nat) (ops : List PersistentNaming.IndexDelta.Op) (s s' : PersistentNaming.IndexDelta.Store), (∀ k, k ∈ List.map PersistentNaming.IndexDelta.Op.key ops → (s k).isSome = (s' k).isSome) → (PersistentNaming.IndexDelta.batch c ops s).2 = (PersistentNaming.IndexDelta.batch c ops s').2

theorems.name: PersistentNaming.IndexDelta.carrier_update_members
theorems.type: ∀ (m : PersistentNaming.IndexDelta.Carriers) (added removed : List Nat) (y : Nat), (PersistentNaming.IndexDelta.carrierUpdate m added removed).1 y = (decide (y ∈ added) || (m y && !decide (y ∈ removed)))

theorems.name: PersistentNaming.IndexDelta.carrier_update_independent_of_group_size
theorems.type: ∀ (m m' : PersistentNaming.IndexDelta.Carriers) (added removed : List Nat), (PersistentNaming.IndexDelta.carrierUpdate m added removed).2 = (PersistentNaming.IndexDelta.carrierUpdate m' added removed).2 ∧ (PersistentNaming.IndexDelta.carrierUpdate m added removed).2 = added.length + removed.length + 1

theorems.name: PersistentNaming.TrackedDeps.currentness_steps_eq
theorems.type: ∀ (deps : List PersistentNaming.TrackedDeps.Key) (events : List PersistentNaming.TrackedDeps.Event), (PersistentNaming.TrackedDeps.currentness deps events).2 = PersistentNaming.TrackedDeps.sumTouched events * (Nat.log2 deps.length + 1) + events.length

theorems.name: PersistentNaming.TrackedDeps.currentness_independent_of_unrelated_deps
theorems.type: ∀ (deps extra : List PersistentNaming.TrackedDeps.Key) (events : List PersistentNaming.TrackedDeps.Event), (∀ k, k ∈ extra → ∀ e, e ∈ events → ¬k ∈ PersistentNaming.TrackedDeps.touched e) → (PersistentNaming.TrackedDeps.currentness (deps ++ extra) events).1 = (PersistentNaming.TrackedDeps.currentness deps events).1 ∧ (PersistentNaming.TrackedDeps.currentness (deps ++ extra) events).2 = (PersistentNaming.TrackedDeps.currentness deps events).2 + PersistentNaming.TrackedDeps.sumTouched events * (Nat.log2 (deps ++ extra).length - Nat.log2 deps.length)
